name: hydrust
description: A Language server for Hydra configuration files built in Rust. Hydrust provides intelligent language features such as hover information, diagnostics, go-to-definition, and more.

hydrust.serverPath.description: Path to the hydra-lsp executable. Takes priority over environment PATH and bundled versions. If empty or invalid, falls back to importStrategy setting.

hydrust.pythonInterpreterPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter. If empty, will use the Python extension's interpreter.

hydrust.importStrategy.description: Strategy for resolving the hydra-lsp executable.
enumDescriptions: Use the hydra-lsp server from the environment (available on PATH), whilst falling back to bundled executable if not found.
Always use the bundled hydra-lsp executable.

hydrust.serverVersion.description: The version of the Hydrust server to download. Use 'latest' for the most recent release, or specify a version like 'v0.1.0'. Only applicable if using the bundled executable.

hydrust.traceServer.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the language server.

hydrust.disabledRules.markdownDescription:
List of diagnostic rules to disable. Available rules: missing-argument, unknown-argument, unresolved-reference, unresolved-import, invalid-hydra-parameter, parameter-already-assigned, too-many-positional-arguments.

_(requires hydra-lsp v0.2.0 or later; the `invalid-hydra-parameter`, `parameter-already-assigned` and `too-many-positional-arguments` rules require v0.3.0 or later)_

hydrust.numThreads.markdownDescription:
Total number of threads the server runs, including the one that handles the protocol itself. The rest are split between a latency pool (hover, completion, semantic tokens) and a worker pool (diagnostics).

Set to 0 for a default the server picks to fit the machine. 1 and 2 are not offered: each pool needs a thread of its own once the protocol thread is accounted for.

_(requires hydra-lsp v0.4.0 or later)_
enumDescriptions: Let the server decide: 6 threads, or fewer on a machine with fewer than 6 CPUs.
1 protocol + 2 latency + 8 worker (the most the server can use)

hydrust.enableHover.markdownDescription:
Enable hover information for hydra targets.

_(requires hydra-lsp v0.2.0 or later)_

hydrust.enableCompletion.markdownDescription:
Enable auto-completion for hydra targets.

_(requires hydra-lsp v0.2.0 or later)_

hydrust.enableSignatureHelp.markdownDescription:
Enable signature help for hydra targets.

_(requires hydra-lsp v0.2.0 or later)_

hydrust.enableGotoDefinition.markdownDescription:
Enable go-to-definition for hydra targets.

_(requires hydra-lsp v0.2.0 or later)_

hydrust.enableSemanticTokens.markdownDescription:
Enable semantic token highlighting.

_(requires hydra-lsp v0.2.0 or later)_

hydrust.enableDiagnostics.markdownDescription:
Enable diagnostics (error/warning reporting).

_(requires hydra-lsp v0.2.0 or later)_

hydrust.developerMode.description: Enable developer mode for verbose diagnostics. When enabled, the extension logs additional internal details (such as raw API payloads on unexpected responses) and surfaces popup notifications directing you to the Hydrust output channel.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: This extension requires a trusted workspace to run the language server.
